practices.practice: Create a single MongoClient per process (module-level singleton) and reuse it rather than creating a client per request.
practices.prior_belief: When creating the Mongo client in Python, configure connection pooling and timeouts explicitly (e.g., pymongo.MongoClient(DOCUMENTDB_URI, maxPoolSize=100, serverSelectionTimeoutMS=5000, connectTimeoutMS=10000, socketTimeoutMS=20000, tls=True)).

practices.practice: Tune connection-pool and timeout parameters according to your hosting model (serverless: small pools, low minPoolSize, short maxIdleTimeMS; long-running servers: larger pools and longer maxIdleTimeMS).
practices.prior_belief: When creating the Mongo client in Python, configure connection pooling and timeouts explicitly (e.g., pymongo.MongoClient(DOCUMENTDB_URI, maxPoolSize=100, serverSelectionTimeoutMS=5000, connectTimeoutMS=10000, socketTimeoutMS=20000, tls=True)).

practices.practice: Always use TLS for client connections and never disable certificate validation in production (include tls=true in the connection string).

practices.practice: Prefer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) authentication and RBAC or per-application secondary users over embedding admin/root credentials in application code.
practices.prior_belief: Avoid using admin/root keys in application code; create least-privilege Mongo users for the app with specific collection-level permissions where supported by the server and rotate credentials periodically.

practices.practice: When available, use managed identities / OIDC (MONGODB-OIDC) with a driver callback (DefaultAzureCredential + OIDC callback) so the app gets short-lived tokens instead of long-lived DB passwords.

practices.practice: Protect clusters with network controls (firewall rules and Private Link / private endpoints) and disable public access where possible for production clusters.

practices.practice: Normalize embeddings at ingest when using cosine similarity, and store the embedding model name and the embedding dimension with each document to detect model drift.
practices.prior_belief: Keep embeddings consistent: store an explicit embedding_dim field in each document, verify all vectors match the same dimension, and reject or normalize mismatched-dimension inserts at ingest time.

practices.practice: Prefer DiskANN for production-scale vector indexes, use HNSW for moderate-sized collections (~up to 50k vectors) and IVF for very small datasets; pick algorithm by scale.

When creating DiskANN/HNSW vector indexes, set and tune parameters (dimensions, similarity, maxDegree, lBuild) and ensure the index 'dimensions' and similarity match the embeddings exactly; rebuild the index if the embedding model changes.
practices.prior_belief: When creating vector indexes, configure HNSW parameters (M, efConstruction) and search-time ef appropriately for your recall/latency tradeoff (e.g., M=16-64, efConstruction=200-400, efSearch tuned per workload) and test on representative data.

practices.practice: At query time, tune query parameters (e.g., lSearch / efSearch and k) and combine vector kNN queries with server-side pre-filters to narrow the candidate set before kNN to preserve recall and reduce cost.
practices.prior_belief: When performing nearest-neighbor search, combine vector similarity with metadata filters server-side (post-filter or index-accelerated filter) to reduce false positives and RU cost of examining many candidates.

practices.practice: Use the DocumentDB search index (createSearchIndexes + $search) for full-text/BM25 search rather than the community $text index; use custom analyzers and fuzzy/phrase operators for richer lexical search.
Combine BM25 keyword search and vector retrieval (hybrid search / RRF) when you want lexical signals plus semantic vectors for higher-quality RAG retrieval.
Create explicit supporting indexes for your common filters and sort patterns (use ESR ordering for compound indexes) to avoid collection scans and reduce RU consumption.
practices.prior_belief: Also create supporting indexes for the common retrieval filters and sort patterns (e.g., compound index on {jurisdiction:1, effective_date:-1, score: -1} or partial indexes for frequently queried subsets) to avoid collection scans.

practices.practice: Keep a small, intentional set of indexes per collection (review $indexStats and hide/drop unused indexes) rather than creating many indexes that increase write cost.

Store source text, embeddings and provenance metadata (source, doc_id/section, embedding_model, embedding_dims) together so retrieval returns both the vector and the text needed for provenance without additional lookups.
practices.prior_belief: Store original text and small chunks in the same document as their embedding and an excerpt_id so you can return provenance without additional lookups; keep chunk size consistent and record chunk boundaries in metadata.

practices.practice: Provide idempotent upserts or versioned documents (schemaVersion or embeddingVersion) for ingest/re-ingest jobs so re-running seeds or backfills doesn't create duplicates and supports safe reindexing.
practices.prior_belief: Use idempotent upsert patterns or versioned documents (incrementing version or etag-like field) during re-ingest so re-running seed or sync jobs does not create duplicates and makes reindexing safe.

practices.practice: Measure request charge / RU consumption for representative RAG flows (embedding writes, vector searches, and retrieval) and optimize by batching writes, projecting fields, and tuning index/search parameters to control costs.
practices.prior_belief: Measure RU consumption for representative RAG flows (embedding writes, ANN searches, and final context assembly) and optimize by batching writes, reducing returned fields, and tuning index/search parameters to control costs.

practices.practice: Enable diagnostics, slow-query logs and alerting (CPU, memory, IOPS, storage, connection saturation and 429 counts) and export them to Log Analytics so you can detect RU pressure and performance regressions.
practices.prior_belief: Enable logging and metrics collection (request charge, latency, 429 counts) and hook them into alerts so provisioning or query changes are driven by observed RU pressure and error patterns.

practices.practice: Enable in-region HA (availability zones) for production clusters and add cross-region replica clusters for disaster recovery; rely on the platform backups (35-day retention) as a baseline but maintain backup/restore runbooks.
Use Premium SSD v2 for new clusters when you need high IOPS/bandwidth and size compute for throughput (IOPS/bandwidth are gated by compute tier, not disk size).

For local development, run the DocumentDB Gateway image (Mongo on port 10260), drive connection/tls relaxation from env vars, and include a 'no-embed' seed mode so developers can populate collections without requiring external embedding keys.
Use projections (field selection) in find/aggregate queries to return only the fields you need and reduce payload size and network transfer.

When building RAG flows and indexes for LlamaIndex/LangChain, store embeddings with documents in the same collection so the vector store and metadata remain co-located and pre-filtering by metadata can be translated into server-side cosmosSearch filters.
Prefer server-side vector indexes and server-side $search + cosmosSearch queries for scale rather than downloading all documents and doing brute-force similarity on the client.

practices.prior_belief: Design the RAG prompt composition to include provenance (source doc id, clause text, jurisdiction, effective_date) and include a link or retrieval id so generated compliance gap reports cite exact clause origins.

practices.practice: Seed and test workflows should use small dedicated test databases/collections with teardown and optionally a no-embedding seed mode to avoid using production data or requiring embedding API keys in CI.

practices.prior_belief: Protect PII and sensitive policy text by applying field-level encryption or encrypting text before storing it if regulatory/PII rules require it, and enforce least-privilege access to collections used for sensitive documents.

practices.practice: Use explain('executionStats') on typical retrieval queries to check index usage (keysExamined/docsExamined) and avoid COLLSCAN before shipping.

notes:
Discovery used the installed DocumentDB skills (connection, driver, vector-search, indexing, security, monitoring, data-modeling, local-deployment, full-text-search, high-availability, storage) and Microsoft Learn documentation pages discovered via queries (examples include the Python quickstart, security and vector-search docs). Almost all prior beliefs were supported by Azure DocumentDB public guidance; one difference surfaced: the public docs specify a 16 MB BSON document limit and advise staying well under it (model recommends staying well under 16 MB) whereas the prior belief recommended a 2 MB practical limit (no Azure DocumentDB doc found that prescribes 2 MB). The repository sample includes a seed_noembed mode and client-side brute-force retrieval for a tiny dataset; production guidance recommends server-side vector indexes and $search/cosmosSearch queries instead.
